newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent lower, March testing $22.50.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent lower, March testing $22.50.

text.p: Brent crude futures in Asia were lower in late trading on Tuesday as players pressed to test sentiment around $22.50 on the March contract.
However, some brokers said the market might find some short covering in London to consolidate recent losses and square up ahead of the API data in New York later on Tuesday.
March Brent, trading on SIMEX, was last traded at $22.45 per barrel, down 13 cents from London's settlement on Monday.
April was quoted at $21.98/$22.05 versus a London settlement of $22.16.
"Personally, I expect a small reversal before the APIs," one broker said. "But any rally will encourage a lot of sellers to come in."
Mild temperature forecasts for the U.S. northeast was keeping the NYMEX complex under pressure.
NYMEX February crude, which expires later in New York, was last traded at $25.05, down 18 cents from New York.
February heating oil, which lost 1.50 cent per gallon in New York, shed a further 0.34 on ACCESS trading in Asia to 66.60 cents.
